name: Juliet Margaretta Hillingham XII
source: She’s a pretty well known girl who comes from the Hillingham royal family. Many of the students are either afraid to talk to her or dislike her based on who she is, thinking that she looks down on others lesser than herself. This is far from the truth as she is actually very kind, gentle and slightly refined as she’s been sheltered for her entire life. She tries to fill her free time with her ever growing list of hobbies on top of being the vice president of the student council.
